assumptions: 100% finalized participation and no skipped epochs: maximal scheduled spend. Actual unearned amounts and integer dust stay in reserve.
Constant hypothetical cost, traffic, fee and conversion value; values are not market quotes, offers or redemption commitments.
NoBaseFee=true local bootstrap does not establish sustainable public fee economics.
Costs omit audits, staffing, redundancy, incident response, taxes, hardware replacement and independent operators.

Current application splits final charged EVM priority fees to the actual proposer, while the base-fee remainder enters SDK distribution. This model assumes a 50/50 composition, not an observed public fee market.
